audience: online shops and warehouse staff who send parcels with Packeta

useCases.title: Validate a packet, then create it
useCases.text: Check the packet data against Packeta's rules first. Then create the packet and get its ID and barcode. A created packet is registered at once.

useCases.title: Track a parcel to its pick-up point
useCases.text: Read the current status of a packet and its last pick-up day. Then read the full tracking history and the destination branch.

useCases.title: List the packets of a shipment
useCases.text: Enter the D-code or B-code of a shipment to list its packets. Then read the courier numbers of one packet.

useCases.title: Get return routing for return labels
useCases.text: Fetch the two return routing strings of your sender account. Print them on return labels, because they can change with the account settings.

useCases.title: Cancel a packet before handover
useCases.text: Cancel a packet that has not been handed over yet. A cancellation cannot be undone.
